oneSentenceConcept: The hero becomes a luxury-tech signal atelier where intent, state, and narrative hierarchy feel actively curated while the rest of the portfolio remains calm and stable.
heroConcept: A moonlit graphite hero with asymmetric stacked type and a luminous signal rail, suggesting an interface that listens, calibrates, and reveals state without becoming a chat surface.
emergingSignals: Pageless intent-aware journeys in luxury AI commerce
Structured agent-state surfaces replacing plain chat streams
Cinematic luxury restraint around technology and hospitality
Archival scene storytelling through paced discovery
Interaction patterns that clarify choice, risk, and fit
visualLanguage: Luxury-tech restraint: dark graphite field, warm high-contrast type, narrow luminous blue accent, and structured signal surfaces that imply adaptive intelligence.
interactionLanguage: The hero behaves like a calibrated state field with subtle signal confirmation; supporting sections use predictable depth reveals and navigation stays structurally stable.
motionLanguage: Cinematic but low-frequency: soft rail reveal, depth lift on important surfaces, and no aggressive cursor or scroll takeover. Reduced motion resolves instantly to clear hierarchy.
storytellingApproach: Hero as prologue and instrument panel; supporting sections unfold as quiet chapters with grid rhythm and no rewritten content.
creativeTechnologyIdeas: AG-UI-inspired state rails represented as visual rhythm rather than chat UI
Token-driven luxury-tech hero treatment using existing hero variants
Progressive disclosure language borrowed from tool-call and approval-state interfaces
typographyDirection: Refined sans display with deliberate negative space; hero type stays bold and architectural while body text remains highly legible.
compositionDirection: Asymmetric hero composition with signal-rail emphasis, followed by grid-rhythm supporting sections and restrained elevated cards.
colorDirection: Moonlit graphite background, warm vellum foreground, and one accessible luminous blue accent for state and affordance emphasis.
textureDirection: Soft shadowed surfaces, thin calibrated borders, and subtle glass-safe mixing only where contrast remains strong.
supportingPageTreatment: Supporting sections inherit the hero's signal rhythm through quiet grid bands, elevated cards, and a stable accent underline in navigation.
avoid: Full-screen AI chat metaphors for the portfolio
